newsitem.title: USA: US debt futures end up, trade impressive,but light.
newsitem.headline: US debt futures end up, trade impressive,but light.

text.p: July 9 - U.S. debt futures closed higher in impressive, but light, trade, analysts said. They said the market had already priced in results of TIPS auction. Some said corporate supply could weigh on T-bonds. Sept T-bonds attempted to re-test 113-31/32 to 114-00. Dec Euros finished slightly below 94.08. ((Chicago derivatives desk (312)408-8750))
